name: Other armed conflicts
value: Ethiopia: Tigray fighting; Badme clashes claimed
summary: Federal forces reportedly retook Rama in Tigray on 7 Nov; Ethiopia–Eritrea clashes near Badme on 9 Nov unconfirmed
state: Federal forces and the Tigray Defence Forces clashed around Rama on 7 Nov, with ACLED reporting that federal forces retook it; Eritrea reinforced Badme and clashes there on 9 Nov were reported but not confirmed, as were Ethiopian drone strikes in Eritrea (Critical Threats, 10 Nov). The army also retook Wurgessa in Amhara from Fano on 10 Nov. Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties on 2 Oct (Africanews). Searches on 16 Nov found no capital under attack and no confirmed interstate war.
for_you: Civilians in Tigray, Amhara and Afar face displacement and disrupted aid. Travellers should follow FCDO advice for Ethiopia and Eritrea, which warns against travel to the affected regions. Confirmed Ethiopia–Eritrea fighting would raise risks across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea.
